## What happened

The incident recorded as INC-0281, titled Booking system outage, affected the booking system from 2026-02-10 to 2026-02-11. During this period, the system was unavailable for the affected service.

## Cause

The recorded cause was Database failover. This incident notice reflects the cause logged for INC-0281.

## Effect

Slot changes lost for a day. Changes made during the incident were therefore not retained for that period. Service users and staff should treat records affected during the outage with care and confirm any information where necessary.

Questions about this notice should be directed to the service desk, quoting INC-0281.
